scope: Dictionary-style verb diagnostics. Full surface lookup remains independent and complete. No book/register mutation.

impersonal: evidenced base participle; no personal finite forms inferred
selection_policy.ordinary_present_3sg: Kept as candidates for the independently owned selective cross-reference ledger, not automatically printed.
selection_policy.scope_vs_reference: A supplied or recognition-only teaching status does not prevent an evidenced dictionary citation.
selection_policy.optional_ge: Preserve explicit source parenthesis notation; never create free lexical prefixes.
selection_policy.no_inflected_participles: Exclude all case/number/gender-marked forms and the six reviewed prose-marked exceptions from unqualified principal-part labels.
selection_policy.bounded_citation_display: One front-matter sentence may explain partial source citations; preserve individual notes for non-infinitive supplied-form headwords and defective modals. The machine scope flag is not permission to omit a known reference cell.
selection_policy.composition_of_final_diagnostics: Use printed_diagnostics as the core. Add selected ordinary pres.3sg candidates only under the independent cross-reference policy; preserve separate positive/negative labels.
selection_policy.attestation_limit: A rule-derived reference form is an explicitly reviewed grammatical formation. It is not asserted to be an independently attested textual token. Exact source words and new reference formations have separate origin_category/evidence_relation fields.
selection_policy.participle_base_selection: Uninflected base/citation only. When explicit optional-ge citation notation exists, prefer it over duplicating that notation plus a bare surface. Keep the all-surface lookup independently unchanged.
selection_policy.unknown_slots: Absent modal participles are marked not supplied by the checked paradigm, not universally unattested. Source-only entries receive no automatically generated paradigms.
